International Standard Atmosphere.fact: The International Standard Atmosphere (ISA) is a static atmospheric model of how the pressure, temperature, density, and viscosity of the Earth's atmosphere change over a wide range of altitudes or elevations.

International Standard Atmosphere.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
International Standard Atmosphere.question: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) publishes the ISA as an international standard, ISO 2533:_____
International Standard Atmosphere.fact: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) publishes the ISA as an international standard, ISO 2533:1975.

International Standard Atmosphere.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
International Standard Atmosphere.question: Other standards organizations, such as the _____ (ICAO) and the United States government, publish extensions or subsets of the same atmospheric model under their own standards-making authority
International Standard Atmosphere.fact: Other standards organizations, such as the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and the United States government, publish extensions or subsets of the same atmospheric model under their own standards-making authority.

International Standard Atmosphere.question: The first model, based on an existing international standard, was published in _____ by the U.S. Committee on Extension to the Standard Atmosphere, and was updated in 1962, 1966, and 1976
International Standard Atmosphere.fact: The first model, based on an existing international standard, was published in 1958 by the U.S. Committee on Extension to the Standard Atmosphere, and was updated in 1962, 1966, and 1976.

International Standard Atmosphere.question: NRLMSISE-00 is a newer model of the Earth's atmosphere from ground to space, developed by the US _____ taking actual satellite drag data into account
International Standard Atmosphere.fact: NRLMSISE-00 is a newer model of the Earth's atmosphere from ground to space, developed by the US Naval Research Laboratory taking actual satellite drag data into account.

International Standard Atmosphere.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
International Standard Atmosphere.question: The COSPAR International Reference Atmosphere (CIRA) _____ and the ISO 14222 Earth Atmosphere Density standard both recommend NRLMSISE-00 for composition uses
International Standard Atmosphere.fact: The COSPAR International Reference Atmosphere (CIRA) 2012 and the ISO 14222 Earth Atmosphere Density standard both recommend NRLMSISE-00 for composition uses. Both CIRA 2012 and ISO 14222 recommend JB2008 for mass density in drag uses.
